news_analysis.headline_hook: The 74% math trap: Why 4 days of upper circuits cost you more than you think.
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Cubex Tubings shares surged 74% over four consecutive trading sessions, hitting an all-time high of ₹152.24 amid a sustained upper circuit streak.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors perceive the 74% gain as a fundamental breakout or a 'get-in-now' momentum play, assuming the stock has entered a new growth trajectory.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: In low-float, small-cap stocks with a market cap of only ₹210 crore, upper circuits are often a symptom of 'artificial scarcity' where low volume allows a small amount of capital to manipulate the price upward, creating a liquidity trap where retail buyers cannot exit once the circuit reverses.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never chase a stock locked in an upper circuit; if you cannot sell, you do not own an asset, you own a trap.
